metadata.Name: Vibravox
metadata.Description: Vibravox is a dataset of French speech captured with body-conduction audio sensors. It contains 45 hours per sensor of speech samples and physiological sounds recorded by 188 participants under different acoustic conditions.
Provider: Conservatoire national des arts et métiers
metadata.Paper Title: Vibravox: A Dataset of French Speech Captured with Body-conduction Audio Sensors
metadata.Venue Title: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
metadata.Venue Name: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
Affiliations: Conservatoire national des arts et métiers
metadata.Abstract: Vibravox is a dataset compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) containing audio recordings using five different body-conduction audio sensors: two in-ear microphones, two bone conduction vibration pickups, and a laryngophone. The dataset also includes audio data from an airborne microphone used as a reference.
